cells.label: Mint shielded → manager account (paired Manager receive+credit in the same tx)
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_A 0→10) + pooled zswap coin (0→10, nonce == the mint nonce)
cells.note: Both call prototypes in ONE ledger Intent — the only cell midnight-js cannot express at SDK level.

cells.label: Mint shielded → user
cells.points: OwnerN wallet SDK (0→10) + ledger conservation (minted == pool + users' holdings)

cells.label: Mint unshielded → manager account
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_A 0→10) + the contract's unshielded ledger balance from the indexer (0→10)
cells.note: No zswap output at all: the mint claims an unshielded spend to the Manager and the Manager claims the input — both are transcript effects, so they offset only inside one intent.

cells.label: Mint unshielded → user
cells.points: OwnerN wallet SDK (0→10) + indexer `unshieldedUtxos` for OwnerN (0→10)

cells.label: Send shielded user→user
cells.points: OwnerN + OwnerM wallet SDK states + ledger conservation identity

cells.label: Split: shielded user wallet change (OwnerN)
cells.points: OwnerN's enumerated coins before/after: the 10-coin is consumed and a 5 change coin created

cells.label: Shielded account→account internal ownership transfer, no ledger movement
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_A 10→5, AA_B 0→5) + pooled coin value AND nonce byte-identical before/after

cells.label: Send shielded user→account (deposit credited to AA_B)
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_B 5→10) + pooled coin (10→15); OwnerN wallet 5→0
cells.note: A SINGLE wallet-balanced call: the Manager declares the receive and the depositor’s wallet supplies the input, so sender spend and Manager receive are in one transaction by construction (FR-003).

cells.label: Merge: pool combines the deposited coin with the held coin
cells.note: The pool stays a SINGLE coin: mergeCoinImmediate consumes both and writes one merged coin with a new nonce.

cells.label: Send shielded account→user (pool pays OwnerM)
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_A 5→0) + pooled coin (15→10); OwnerM wallet 5→10
cells.note: The wallet detected and can spend the CONTRACT-CREATED output — proven when OwnerM re-spends it in step 7.

cells.label: Split: shielded contract change coin retained in the pool
cells.note: sendShielded returned a non-empty change arm; the Manager wrote the change coin back to itself.

cells.label: Send unshielded user→user
cells.points: OwnerN + OwnerM wallet SDK states + the indexer’s `unshieldedUtxos` for both addresses

cells.label: Split: unshielded user UTXO split into sent + change (OwnerN)
cells.points: OwnerN UTXOs ["10"] → ["5"]; OwnerM gained ["5"]
cells.note: The consumed 10-UTXO and the two 5 outputs are both recorded.

cells.label: Unshielded account→account internal ownership transfer, no ledger movement
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_A 10→5, AA_B 0→5) + the contract's unshielded ledger balance unchanged at 10

cells.label: Send unshielded user→account
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_B 5→10) + contract unshielded ledger balance (10→15); OwnerN wallet and indexer both 5→0

cells.label: Send unshielded account→user
cells.points: Manager account map (AA_A 5→0) + contract unshielded ledger balance (15→10); OwnerM wallet and indexer 5→10

cells.label: Split: unshielded partial pooled-balance spend
cells.points: the contract held 15 and paid out 5, retaining 10

cells.label: Provenance: user re-sends AA-originated shielded coins
cells.points: OwnerM's wallet spent coins CREATED BY THE MANAGER in step 4 (10→5) + Manager account map AA_A 0→5
cells.note: This is the direct proof that the pinned wallet SDK detects and can spend contract-created zswap outputs — the spec’s Edge Case risk does not apply.

cells.label: Provenance: AA account re-sends user-originated shielded value
cells.points: AA_B's holdings include OwnerN's step-4 deposit; account map 10→5 + pooled coin pays out and retains change

cells.label: Provenance: user re-sends AA-originated unshielded tokens
cells.points: OwnerM spends UTXOs paid out by the Manager in step 6 (wallet + indexer both 10→5) + account map AA_A 0→5

cells.label: Provenance: AA account re-sends user-originated unshielded tokens
cells.points: AA_B re-spends OwnerN's step-6 deposit; account map 10→5 + contract ledger balance falls by 5

cells.label: Self-send: user shielded to own key
cells.points: OwnerM balance unchanged at 5; coins ["5"] → ["2","3"] with new commitments

cells.label: Self-send: user unshielded UTXO self-split
cells.points: OwnerM balance unchanged at 5 (wallet AND indexer); UTXOs ["5"] → ["2","3"]

cells.label: Self-send: pool shielded to `kernel.self()` via auto-receive
cells.points: pool value unchanged at 10; nonce c4c651a534477e79461a9f4e2974c67ae245f58cb75b078d4b7f0088a236a800 → bb9e3d5ce419284e14935d9eb41bfaa6200e69ca84e95d1e3550eb0e52654200; account map byte-identical
cells.note: The only cell that reaches the standard library’s auto-receive branch: sendShielded to kernel.self() re-claims its own output.

cells.label: Self-send: pool unshielded to self via auto-receive
cells.points: contract ledger balance and account map BOTH byte-identical at 10
cells.note: sendUnshielded to kernel.self() takes the auto-receive branch (incUnshieldedInputs), so the contract balance nets to zero.

cells.label: Invariant: `pooled holdings = AA_A + AA_B` per family, after EVERY step
cells.points: asserted in `assertAll` after all ten steps, in both families, against two independently maintained mechanisms
cells.note: Shielded: pooled zswap coin value vs the account map. Unshielded: the contract’s ledger balance from the indexer vs the account map.
